components.name: Default Button
components.description: Every action that is not the main one.

components.name: Record Button
components.description: The toolbar Record toggle, the one Record control; it fills red, counts the steps and pulses its dot while recording.
components.css: .ds-record { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 12px 0 10px; border: 1px solid #3c3f45; border-radius: 6px; background: #25272b; color: #e8e9eb; font: 500 13px/1.45 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-record:hover { background: #2f3136; } .ds-record:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4fbf98; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-record-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #d43b40; } .ds-record-live { border-color: #d43b40; background: #d43b40; color: #fff; } .ds-record-live:hover { background: #e2494e; border-color: #e2494e; } .ds-record-live .ds-record-dot { background: #fff; animation: ds-rec 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-rec { 50% { opacity: 0.35; } }

components.name: Quiet Button

components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #b0b4bb; font: 500 13px/1.45 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), color 120ms; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 7%); color: #e8e9eb; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4fbf98; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Field

components.name: Segmented Control

components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #3c3f45; border-radius: 6px; background: #151619; } .ds-seg button { min-height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #b0b4bb; font: 400 13px/1.45 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #e8e9eb; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #2f3136; color: #e8e9eb; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4fbf98; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Menu

components.css: .ds-clip-lane { position: relative; height: 92px; width: 360px; background: #151619; border-bottom: 1px solid #2c2e33; } .ds-clip { --l: #ee8a3c; position: absolute; top: 6px; bottom: 6px; left: 8px; right: 8px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--l) 70%, #1c1d20); border-radius: 5px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--l) 34%, #1c1d20); cursor: grab; transition: box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-clip:hover, .ds-clip:focus-visible { border-color: #4fbf98; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #4fbf98; outline: none; } .ds-clip-shot { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 22px; background: #0f1012; } .ds-clip-caption { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 22px; padding: 0 10px 0 4px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--l) 34%, #1c1d20); color: #e8e9eb; font: 400 12px/1 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-clip-number { display: grid; place-items: center; min-width: 16px; height: 16px; padding: 0 3px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--l); color: #101114; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-clip-title { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-clip-time { color: #b0b4bb; }

narrative.overview:
The studio is a video editor for tutorials, built to the category standard with Camtasia as the craft reference. A dark workspace of charcoal panels surrounds a near-black stage where the step is shown. Panels are separated by hairlines, not by gaps or cards. The tutorial reads left to right on a timeline of tracks, with a playhead across them.

Color is functional and scarce. Everything is grey except three signals: the green of the logo for the main action, selection and focus; red only for recording; and the label color of each theme, carried by its clips like clip colors in an editor. Type is Segoe UI Variable at a compact 13px, so long sessions fit a lot on screen, and every time and count uses tabular figures so numbers do not jump while playing.

Two screens share the system. The library is a project browser: sites in a left panel, the tutorials of the open site grouped by theme as thumbnails. The editor is the editing bay: toolbar, steps panel, viewer with its bar and transport, properties panel, and the timeline below.
keyCharacteristics: Three panel depths (stage, app, panel) plus raised controls, divided by 1px hairlines.
The greens of the logo for the main action, selection and focus; red for recording and nothing else.
The real logo, three white bars on its green tile, at the head of the library and on the toolbar's Library button.
One Record control, at the top left of the toolbar; the viewer keeps its bar in every view.
Theme label colors used as clip colors on the timeline and as dots in the library.
Segoe UI Variable, 13px body, tabular figures for every time and count.
Flat panels; shadows only on things that float (menus, dialogs, toasts, the zoom bar, a dragged clip).

rules.name: The Record Red Rule
rules.body: Record red marks recording and nothing else: the Record button, its dot, and the frame of the browser while it records. Destructive actions use the separate danger red, and only in the confirmation step.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green means "this is the main action" or "this is selected". One filled green button per screen; every other button is grey. Logo Green belongs to the logo alone.

rules.name: The Clip Color Rule
rules.body: Label colors belong to themes. They color clips, dots and number badges, never buttons, text or panels.

rules.name: The Tabular Time Rule
rules.body: Every time, duration, count and step number is set with tabular figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`), so values do not shift while the playhead moves.

rules.name: The Compact Scale Rule
rules.body: Body text is 13px. Sizes come from the seven-step scale (11, 12, 13, 14, 16, 20, 26px); nothing larger than 26px appears in the interface.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels, toolbars and tracks have no shadow. If it does not float, it does not cast one.

rules.name: The Screenshot Edge Rule
rules.body: Every screenshot thumbnail carries a 1px white edge at 10% opacity, inset, so light pages keep their outline on dark panels.

rules.name: The Single Record Rule
rules.body: Recording starts and stops from one control, the toggle at the top left of the toolbar. The empty viewer repeats it only while a tutorial has no step yet.

dos: **Do** separate regions with 1px hairlines (line, line-strong) on tonal depths, not with gaps, cards or shadows.
**Do** keep one filled green button per screen, for its main action.
**Do** use Selection Green (accent-text) for every focus outline, focused border, selected item and the playhead.
**Do** set every time, duration, count and step number with tabular figures.
**Do** color clips, theme dots and clip numbers with the theme's label color, and keep the label off everything else.
**Do** use the shared button, field, segmented, menu and dialog styles; size small controls with the small and icon variants and keep their extended hit area.
**Do** draw icons from the studio's 24px line set at stroke 1.75, in the current text color.
**Do** give every screenshot thumbnail the faint white inset edge.
**Do** draw the logo with its component, in its own green.
**Do** honor reduced motion: transitions and animations drop to 1ms.
donts: **Don't** use record red for anything but recording.
**Don't** add a second Record control or a tab that splits the steps into another view of the same screenshots.
**Don't** put shadows on panels, toolbars, tracks or rows; only floating things lift.
**Don't** introduce a light theme surface, a card dashboard, or web-form page layout inside the studio.
**Don't** set interface text above 26px or below 11px, or use a face other than Segoe UI Variable.
**Don't** add uppercase tracked labels above headings; uppercase 11px is for panel group headers only, and it is the heading itself.
**Don't** open a dialog for anything but naming something new or confirming a deletion.
